invariants: A corrected file must be complete and independently usable; it must not depend on an addendum or patch fragment.
A root fix is incomplete until every file affected by that change is corrected.
The superseded file must not remain active after its validated replacement exists.
Historical Git commit history may retain prior content, but no current authoritative repository path or reference may rely on the superseded file.
Unknown consequences must be classified UNKNOWN and must not be silently assumed safe.
